title: Microsoft Copilot data protection: Zscaler Copilot Security for Microsoft

{{cdp-risk}} How the product relates to Zscaler's DLP, CASB and DSPM offerings is open {{gap:cdp-pillar}}. The DSPM and CASB subjects are [[dspm.overview]] and [[portfolio.casb]].

Whether the deployment guide is captured is open {{gap:cdp-guide}}. Whether Copilot indexes SharePoint and Teams data too is open {{gap:cdp-sources}}. Whether the product has its own SDK is open {{gap:cdp-sdk}}.

checks.do: Before stating a Copilot deployment step, check whether the deployment guide is captured; if it is not, say the step is open.
For a question about which Copilot data sources are covered, answer with OneDrive only and name the SharePoint and Teams question as open.

cdp-marketed.statement: The page's headline is Control Data Security and Oversharing in Microsoft Copilot; its breadcrumb names it Microsoft Copilot Data Protection, and it links a data sheet titled Zscaler Copilot Security for Microsoft.

quotes:
Control Data Security and Oversharing in Microsoft Copilot
Enforce safe guardrails for Copilot data access while maintaining your security posture.

Find a Product, Solution, or Technology
>Microsoft Copilot Data Protection

Data sheet
Zscaler Copilot Security for Microsoft

cdp-four.statement: The page's product overview lists four capabilities: see and control prompts (visibility into Copilot user prompts and blocking sensitive data inputs with DLP), fix OneDrive data permissions, update Purview labels, and close dangerous misconfigurations in Copilot or Microsoft 365 configurations.

quotes:
See and control prompts:
Get full visibility into Copilot user prompts, and block sensitive data inputs with DLP.

Fix OneDrive data permissions:
Prevent Copilot oversharing by removing excessive sharing permissions.

Update Purview labels:
Add missing Purview sensitivity labels to data in order to restrict Copilot access.

Close dangerous misconfigurations:
Find and close Copilot or Microsoft 365 configurations that expose data.

cdp-onedrive.statement: The page names OneDrive permissions as a challenge, saying improperly permissioned data can be consumed and shared too widely, and its product details say to remove overpermissioned OneDrive access.

quotes:
OneDrive permissions
Improperly permissioned data can be consumed and shared too widely.
Remove overpermissioned OneDrive access and ensure proper Purview labels.

cdp-paths.statement: The page says Zscaler takes an approach to API and inline security that enables control over Copilot deployments, ensuring access constraints around sensitive data across the Microsoft tenant.

quotes: Zscaler takes a unique approach to API and inline security that enables robust control over Copilot deployments, ensuring proper access constraints around sensitive data across your Microsoft tenant.

cdp-risk.statement: The page says Copilot can overconsume and share sensitive data with underprivileged users and that, although Microsoft provides Copilot Security options, challenges remain: besides OneDrive permissions, sensitive data users fail to label is open to access by Copilot prompts, and gaps in Microsoft 365 and Copilot configurations can expose data.

quotes: Unfortunately, it can also overconsume and share sensitive data with underprivileged users. Microsoft provides Copilot Security options, yet several challenges remain:

Purview labeling
If users fail to label sensitive data properly, it’s open to access by Copilot prompts.

Copilot misconfigurations
Gaps in Microsoft 365 and Copilot configurations can expose data to risks.

cdp-guide.title: Whether the Copilot deployment guide is captured and canonical
cdp-guide.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Vendored deployment guide is the canonical operational reference.' The earlier non-verbatim capture of the page named Zscaler-Microsoft-Copilot-Deployment-Guide-FINAL.pdf under vendor/zscaler-help/downloads/, but that file is not in the repository and no capture of it exists; the current page links a data sheet, a blog post, a white paper and a webinar, not a deployment guide.

cdp-sources.title: Which Microsoft data sources Copilot indexes
cdp-sources.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Copilot indexes data from OneDrive / SharePoint / Teams and can surface it to underprivileged users via prompts.' The capture names OneDrive only.

cdp-api-inline.title: Which Copilot capability uses the API path and which the inline path
cdp-api-inline.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'API-based (data classification, permissions) and inline (prompt DLP) integration paths.' The capture says both paths exist and does not map capabilities to them.

cdp-sdk.title: Whether the Copilot product has its own SDK surface
cdp-sdk.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'No SDK surface specific to this product.' The vendored SDK code mentions Copilot only as a cloud-app category value, not as a product surface, but no captured page states the product has or lacks an API.

cdp-pillar.title: Whether Copilot security sits in a Data Security pillar alongside DLP, CASB and DSPM
cdp-pillar.detail: Unverified legacy statement: the earlier non-verbatim capture of the Copilot security page said the product is part of Zscaler's Data Security pillar within the unified Zero Trust platform and complements existing DLP, CASB and DSPM solutions. The current page does not say this.
